detail.title: Divergent Values Research and Interpretation
detail.summary: This cycle evaluates the recent inconclusive experiment (exp-divergent-values-test-137) regarding path-dependent value divergence. While the divergence variance delta exceeded the prediction threshold, the results remain unvalidated and speculative. The decision is to continue the investigation with refined experimental parameters to test the sensitivity of the system.
